object_cleaning.definition: Wash, rinse, scrub or wipe inanimate objects and fixtures: dishes, textiles, tools, tables, counters, sinks, shelves, appliances. Not human hygiene or floor/room cleanup.

environment_cleaning.definition: Sweep, mop or vacuum floors, collect/dispose of trash, clean an overall room or work area. A small trash-removal step before wiping a table stays object_cleaning.

object_organizing.definition: Sort, arrange, store, stack, fold, hang, coil or untangle items for organization. Includes clothes, documents, inventory and personal items; not packaging products for shipment.

object_packaging.definition: Pack/unpack goods, assemble packaging around goods, seal boxes/bags or wrap packages. Folding an empty box to make packaging belongs here.

object_labeling.definition: Apply/remove identification labels, shipping labels, price tags or markings. Scanning labels belongs to object_inspection.

object_transport.definition: Carry, transfer, load or unload goods between locations. Small picking/placing to sort/store items stays object_organizing.

object_assembly.definition: Assemble, disassemble, install or detach product parts or components. Packaging construction stays object_packaging; repairing an existing device stays object_maintenance.

object_maintenance.definition: Repair, maintain, replace batteries/consumables, charge devices, restore or service equipment. Cosmetic maintenance of people belongs to personal-care classes.

object_inspection.definition: Inspect, measure, count, test or scan goods as the principal goal, including barcode scanning.

object_processing.definition: Modify materials or make crafts by cutting, sewing, stapling, binding, punching, threading or shaping. Not food processing, hairstyling or packaging.

object_filling.definition: Fill, pour, dispense or replenish nonfood materials into containers, e.g. soap or cleaning liquid. Applying products to people is personal care; food/drink portioning is food_preparation.

object_operation.definition: Operate, switch, connect or configure a device as the main goal without a more specific activity. Do not classify food cooking or hair drying here just because an appliance is used.

food_preparation.definition: Prepare, cut, peel, cook, heat, portion, plate or serve food/drinks, including brewing tea/coffee. Washing dishes or cleaning kitchen counters stays object_cleaning.

hair_styling.definition: Cut, trim, dye, perm, straighten, braid, curl, section, style or attach hair extensions, on customers or mannequin/wig hair. Mixing dye for hair coloring also belongs here.

hair_care.definition: Wash, rinse, condition, treat, brush or dry hair for basic care. Drying as a support step in a full haircut does not override hair_styling. Organizing combs/rods is object_organizing.

nail_care.definition: Trim, file, polish, paint, decorate, clean or extend human nails. Organizing nail-polish bottles is object_organizing.

skin_care.definition: Cleanse skin/face, apply skincare products, masks, lotions or skin-treatment devices. Massage as a principal goal is body_care, decorative cosmetics is makeup_application.

makeup_application.definition: Apply/remove decorative makeup, foundation, eye shadow, eyeliner, lipstick or false eyelashes. Skincare lotions/serums without decorative makeup stay skin_care.

body_care.definition: Massage any body region, perform moxibustion, cupping, scraping or physical body treatment, including facial massage as a principal purpose.

writing_drawing.definition: Write, draw, record, complete forms or create written/visual marks as the main goal. Sticking identification labels is object_labeling.

sports_recreation.definition: Exercise, play sports, games or toys as the main goal. Tidying sports/game equipment is object_organizing.

other.definition: Insufficient evidence, no suitable category, or unrelated equally important goals spanning different categories. Multiple objects within ONE broad category should NOT become other.
